notes.title: Final update
notes.content:
[b]Hey dear Spaceship friends[/b]

We haven't spoken here for a long time.
But for now, thank you for playing and all your support.
We are not only making Spaceship Racer, but also many other games
that you can currently play on Steam like [b]Bearskull, Louma. A Void Shaper[/b] and [b]many other games.[/b]

Spaceship Racer portal is a game that started as a mini game in Neospace, in neospace there is a small arcade machine where you can play a mini version of this game, our idea was to expand this game and develop it as a standalone game.

However, we have noticed that we have made a lot of progress. However, we didn't want to leave Spaceship Racer lying around now, so we have taken your current feedback to heart in order to carry out a final patch.

[u]Of course, we will be fixing bugs in the future and are even prepared to develop a community update if there is interest and cool ideas come up.[/u]

As you can see, you are really important to us, because we are gamers and we develop these games for gamers.
But now I don't want to keep on texting you, here is the complete list.

[u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Store can now be scrolled faster
[*] Prices have been lowered (real money)
[*] Resurrection now works with ingame money
[*] Destroying asteroids now earns points (points = money)
[*] 3 new music tracks have been added
[*] French has been added
[*] Dutch has been added
[*] Spanish has been added
[*] Italian has been added
[*] Portuguese has been added
[*] Turkish has been added
[/list]

You've read this far, so we'll tell you the spaceship code for the [b]Makis Adventure spaceship[/b] (which is the game from a friend of ours)

[u][b]Here is the code:[/b][/u] MakiCode1

Thanks to all of you!

Robin Hoffmann - CEO of DreamStudios

notes.title: Bug fix and UI update
notes.content:
[b]Hello dear space friends[/b]

We've made minor adjustments to the game. Below that are reported bugs, and a small UI update as we found the main menu to be very cluttered.

Feel free to give us feedback so we can make the game even better, we still have a lot to do and this is just the beginning.

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[i]-main menu UI partially replaced
-Main menu UI buttons can now be found in Settings
-Window closing now only over the star
-Power UP robot now has a shot sound
-Man can no longer get out of the map[/i]

Many thanks to everyone for playing
we look forward to your further feedback

[i]We look forward to the future
dream studio[/i]
